title: J2 seal media / temperature qualification envelope
documented_process_facts: MARV 2EX is used for wet, potentially explosive process gases.
BOF/BF application documentation states CO may reach approximately 60 vol% and moisture is high.
Nitrogen is used for purge/protective functions.
System documentation places sample gas entering the optical module at approximately 100–120 °C.
K01 local J2 elastomer temperature is not yet independently proven to equal the optical-cell gas temperature; local seal temperature must be bounded separately.
release_required_inputs: J2-local minimum/normal/maximum metal and elastomer temperature
process-gas species and concentration envelope at J2 for the released application
trace acid / sulfur / hydrocarbon / solvent species if applicable
cleaning agents that may contact J2
required service interval and leak acceptance

material_strategy.use_condition: release only after supplier chemical-compatibility confirmation and compression/leak qualification for the bounded BOF/media envelope
material_strategy.fallback_trigger: media envelope contains species incompatible/conditional for selected FKM, or application variability cannot be bounded economically
material_strategy.excluded_as_default: silicone/VMQ due to high gas permeability and optical-contamination concern

decision: Do not freeze a universal elastomer before the J2-local environment is bounded. Carry FKM 75A as the production candidate for the current BOF baseline; carry FFKM as the controlled fallback.
